data.data:
Dear Endministrator,

The Arknights: Endfield Real-Time Game Data Panel is now live in the GRYPHLINK launcher. You can log into your Gryphline Account in the GRYPHLINK launcher, then click the [View Character Dashboard] icon on the right side of the launcher to view select of your real-time game data for Arknights: Endfield.


GRYPHLINK Arknights: Endfield Real-Time Game Data Panel | FAQ


Q: What is the GRYPHLINK Arknights: Endfield Real-Time Game Data Panel?

A: The Real-Time Game Data Panel is a feature in the GRYPHLINK launcher that displays Arknights: Endfield game data linked to your Gryphline Account. Once enabled, it allows you to view select real-time data, such as Sanity, Daily Activity Points, and Weekly Routine, even when the game is offline.


Q: How do I access the Real-Time Game Data Panel?

A: Log into your Gryphline Account in the GRYPHLINK launcher, then click the [View Character Dashboard] icon on the right side of the launcher to view select real-time game data from Arknights: Endfield.


Q: Why can't I find this entry point in the GRYPHLINK launcher?

A: Please make sure you are logged into your Gryphline Account in the launcher and have already created a character in Arknights: Endfield.


Q: Why does some data on the panel differ from what I see in-game?

A: Results shown may lag behind in-game activity. Please refer to in-game data for the latest figures.


Q: I have multiple characters under my Gryphline Account. How can I view real-time data for different characters?

A: Log into your Gryphline Account in the GRYPHLINK launcher and click [View Character Dashboard] to open the real-time data panel at the bottom. Click [Switch] next to your current character nickname on the left to select another character under the same Gryphline Account and view their real-time data.


※ If you encounter any issues or have suggestions while experiencing, please feel free to contact Customer Support. Thank you for your understanding and support!
